technique_name: Describe the safety protocols for safely handling hazardous materials.
description: Safety protocols for handling hazardous materials include wearing protective gear such as gloves, goggles, and face masks; ensuring good ventilation in the working area; removing all combustible materials; labeling containers properly; being aware of any potential reactions between different materials; and always following the manufacturer’s instructions.
